method.interval: nominal95 stratified paired-root bootstrap; both roles and arms together; equal fixed-style weight

limitations: Both fixed checkpoints played the same scripted/formula opponent roster; this is not head-to-head or a self-play win rate.
The 64 training-excluded styles were previously evaluated, not a fresh unseen holdout.
Baseline-only comparison cannot distinguish the hand-clock change from additional training.
Deterministic argmax results are not stochastic training policy rates.
Intervals condition on fixed checkpoints, styles and 160-hand horizon; they exclude training-seed uncertainty.
Zero-event bootstrap intervals do not prove zero population probability; zero-denominator rates remain null.
Private evidence and model binaries are not included in this results directory.

win_analysis.primary_metric: equal-style difference in actual win-by-H probability
win_analysis.denominator: all planned games, including unfinished; each fixed style receives equal weight
win_analysis.unfinished_interpretation: unresolved by H; not a loss, draw, or score-lead winner
win_analysis.horizon_sensitivity_warning: Win-by-H is sensitive to finishing speed and stalling; it is not eventual match-win strength. Read paired unresolved-by-H alongside terminal W/L/D. Missing planned chunks are not unfinished games.
win_analysis.intervals: nominal 95% percentile stratified paired-root bootstrap; fixed roster; no multiplicity correction
